entries.title: Proverbs 11:1
segments: ¶A false balance [is] abomination to the LORD: but a just weight [is] his delight. {A false...: Heb. Balances of deceit} {just...: Heb. perfect stone}

words.text: . {A false...: Heb. Balances of deceit} {just...: Heb. perfect stone}

entries.title: Proverbs 11:2
segments: ¶[When] pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly [is] wisdom.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:3
segments: ¶The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:4
segments: ¶Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:5
segments: ¶The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness. {direct: Heb. rectify}

entries.title: Proverbs 11:6
segments: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in [their own] naughtiness.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:7
segments: ¶When a wicked man dieth, [his] expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust [men] perisheth.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:8
segments: ¶The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:9
segments: ¶An hypocrite with [his] mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:10
segments: ¶When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, [there is] shouting.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:11
segments: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:12
segments: ¶He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace. {void...: Heb. destitute of heart}

entries.title: Proverbs 11:13
segments: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter. {A talebearer: Heb. He that walketh, being a talebearer}

entries.title: Proverbs 11:14
segments: ¶Where no counsel [is], the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors [there is] safety.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:15
segments: ¶He that is surety for a stranger shall smart [for it]: and he that hateth suretiship is sure. {smart: Heb. be sore broken} {suretiship: Heb. those that strike hands}

words.text: . {smart: Heb. be sore broken} {suretiship: Heb. those that strike hands}

entries.title: Proverbs 11:16
segments: ¶A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong [men] retain riches.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:17
segments: ¶The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but [he that is] cruel troubleth his own flesh.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:18
segments: ¶The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness [shall be] a sure reward.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:19
segments: ¶As righteousness [tendeth] to life: so he that pursueth evil [pursueth it] to his own death.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:20
segments: ¶They that are of a froward heart [are] abomination to the LORD: but [such as are] upright in [their] way [are] his delight.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:21
segments: ¶[Though] hand [join] in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:22
segments: ¶[As] a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, [so is] a fair woman which is without discretion. {is without: Heb. departeth from}

entries.title: Proverbs 11:23
segments: ¶The desire of the righteous [is] only good: [but] the expectation of the wicked [is] wrath.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:24
segments: ¶There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and [there is] that withholdeth more than is meet, but [it tendeth] to poverty.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:25
segments: ¶The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself. {liberal...: Heb. soul of blessing}

words.text: also himself. {liberal...: Heb. soul of blessing}

entries.title: Proverbs 11:26
segments: ¶He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing [shall be] upon the head of him that selleth [it].

entries.title: Proverbs 11:27
segments: ¶He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:28
segments: ¶He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:29
segments: ¶He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool [shall be] servant to the wise of heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:30
segments: ¶The fruit of the righteous [is] a tree of life; and he that winneth souls [is] wise. {winneth: Heb. taketh}

entries.title: Proverbs 11:31
segments: ¶Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
